# Port of lib/pubid/cie/parser.rb — CIE identifiers: standards with
# iteration/part/separator variants and legacy or current dates,
# language forms (slash, paren, paren-year), DIS+SP supplements,
# conference proceedings (xNNN papers), D-series, joint forms with
# ISO/ISO-CIE/IEC, the identical-(ISO ...) form, and the IEC dual.
#
# Edition-2 conversion. Deviations from the v1 tree:
# - the zero-width markers ("" as dash_sep) and ("" as slash_sep) are
#   re-spelled as real-token captures of the separator they marked:
#   `dash as dash_sep` and `slash as slash_sep`. The keys stay present
#   exactly when the dash/slash part form matched, so the builder's
#   truthiness checks keep their meaning (the bound values are "-" and
#   "/" instead of "").
# - the builder dispatches the date style, the language format and the
#   standard_identifier word order on the wrapper keys (current_date,
#   legacy_date, language_slash, language_paren, language_paren_year,
#   lang_before, date_then_lang, trailing_lang), so all eight keep
#   their v1 nested shapes and bind uncast with (raw).
# - year_digits is inlined (century 2*digit !digit) at every capture
#   site: a capture over a ref to a composite rule leaks the rule's
#   self-wrapped named nodes and would bind an array.
# - the composite s_prefix/stage_code rules are inlined at capture
#   sites for the same reason; the unused full_number wrapper capture
#   is dropped (the builder never read it).
# - pure-raw rule bodies (digits, letters) are inlined so every capture
#   binds one scalar span.

grammar PubidCie version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  colon = ":"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"
  lparen = "("
  rparen = ")"
  century = "19" / "20"
  year_digits = century 2*digit !digit

  legacy_date = (dash (century 2*digit !digit) as year) as legacy_date
  current_date = (colon (century 2*digit !digit) as year) as current_date
  date = current_date / legacy_date

  code_with_iteration = ((1*digit)) as number dot ((1*digit)) as iteration
  code_with_part_and_iteration_slash = {
    ((1*digit)) as number
    slash
    ((1*digit)) as part
    dot
    ((1*digit)) as iteration
  }
  code_with_part_and_iteration_dash = {
    ( ((1*digit)) as number dash ((1*digit)) as part dot ((1*digit)) as iteration )
    !dash
  }
  code_with_part_dash = {
    ( ((1*digit)) as number dash as dash_sep ((1*3digit)) as part )
    (!(century))
    (!(dot / dash))
  }
  code_with_part_slash = {
    ( ((1*digit)) as number slash as slash_sep ((1*digit)) as part )
    !dot
  }
  code_simple = ((1*digit)) as number
  code = {
    code_with_part_and_iteration_slash
    / code_with_part_and_iteration_dash
    / code_with_iteration
    / code_with_part_slash
    / code_with_part_dash
    / code_simple
  }

  language_slash = ((slash (upper) as lang_code)) as language_slash
  language_paren = ((lparen ((1*3(upper / lower))) as lang_code rparen)) as language_paren
  language_paren_year = {
    (
      ( ([space]) lparen ((2*upper)) as lang_code dash (century 2*digit !digit) as trans_year rparen )
    ) as language_paren_year
  }
  language = language_paren_year / language_paren / language_slash

  x_prefix = "x"
  doc_type = "TR" / "TS"
  paper_code = ((1*upper)) as paper_code
  variant_slug = slash ((1*(digit / lower))) as variant

  conf_proceedings = "CIE" space "x" ((1*digit)) as conf_number dash paper_code ((1*digit)) as paper_number
  standalone_proceedings = "CIE" space paper_code ((1*digit)) as paper_number space (((1*digit) dash (1*digit))) as page_range
  d_series_identifier = "CIE" space "D" as d_prefix ((1*digit)) as number date
  standard_with_slash_year = {
    "CIE" space
    [ (("FDIS" / "DIS" / "DS") space) as stage ]
    [ ("S" space) as s_prefix ]
    ((1*digit)) as number
    [ (dot ((1*digit)) as iteration) ]
    slash
    ((century 2*digit !digit)) as slash_year
  }
  dis_with_supplement = {
    "CIE" space
    (("FDIS" / "DIS" / "DS") space) as stage
    [ ("S" space) as s_prefix ]
    ((1*digit)) as base_number
    dash "SP"
    ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
    [ (dot ((1*digit)) as supplement_part) ]
    slash
    (upper) as lang_code
    (colon) as lang_colon
    (century 2*digit !digit) as year
  }
  standard_identifier = {
    "CIE" space
    [ (("FDIS" / "DIS" / "DS") space) as stage ]
    [ ("S" space) as s_prefix ]
    code
    [
      ( ((language date)) as lang_before
      / ((date [language])) as date_then_lang
      / date
      )
    ]
  }
  standard_with_language_year = {
    "CIE" space
    [ (("FDIS" / "DIS" / "DS") space) as stage ]
    [ ("S" space) as s_prefix ]
    code
    slash
    (upper) as lang_code
    (colon) as lang_colon
    (century 2*digit !digit) as year
  }
  conference_identifier = "CIE" space x_prefix as conference ((1*digit)) as conf_number date [(space "Amendment" space ((1*digit)) as amd_number)] [variant_slug]
  joint_with_iso = {
    (
      "CIE" space
      "ISO" as copublisher
      !slash space
      [ ((doc_type) space) as doc_type ]
      [ (("FDIS" / "DIS" / "DS") space) as stage ]
      ((1*digit)) as number
      [ (dash ((1*digit)) as part) ]
      [
        ( (colon (century 2*digit !digit) as year)
        / (dash (century 2*digit !digit) as year)
        )
      ]
      [language]
    )
  }
  joint_with_iso_cie = {
    (
      "CIE" space
      "ISO/CIE" as copublisher
      space
      [ ((doc_type) space) as doc_type ]
      ((1*digit)) as number
      [ (colon (century 2*digit !digit) as year) ]
      [language]
    )
  }
  joint_with_iec = {
    (
      "CIE" space
      "IEC" as copublisher
      space
      ((1*digit)) as number
      dot
      ((1*digit)) as part
      dash
      (century 2*digit !digit) as year
    )
  }
  identical_with_iso = {
    (
      "CIE" space
      [ ("S" space) as s_prefix ]
      ((1*digit)) as number
      [
        ( (dot ((1*digit)) as iteration)
        / (dash ((1*digit)) as part)
        )
      ]
      [
        (
          slash
          (
            (((upper)) as lang_code (colon) as lang_colon (century 2*digit !digit) as year)
            / (((upper)) as lang_code (century 2*digit !digit) as year)
            / (((century 2*digit !digit)) as slash_year)
          )
        )
      ]
      space "(ISO" space
      (
        (
          ((1*(digit / upper / colon / slash / dot / dash)))
          [ (lparen 1*upper rparen) ]
        )
      ) as iso_reference
      rparen
    )
  }
  dual_with_iec = {
    (
      "CIE" space
      [ ("S" space) as s_prefix ]
      ((1*digit)) as number
      colon
      (century 2*digit !digit) as year
      slash "IEC" space
      ((1*nonrparen_nl)) as iec_identifier
    )
  }
  supplement_identifier = {
    (
      "CIE" space
      ((1*digit)) as base_number
      dash "SP"
      ((1*digit)) as supplement_number
      [ (dot ((1*digit)) as supplement_part) ]
      [ (colon (century 2*digit !digit) as year) ]
      [language_portion]
    )
  }
  corrigendum_identifier = {
    (
      "CIE" space
      ((1*digit)) as base_number
      [
        (
          dash "SP" ((1*digit)) as base_supplement
          [ (dot ((1*digit)) as base_supplement_part) ]
        )
      ]
      colon
      (century 2*digit !digit) as base_year
      slash "Cor"
      ((1*digit)) as cor_number
      colon
      (century 2*digit !digit) as cor_year
    )
  }
  bundle_identifier = {
    (
      "CIE" space
      ((1*digit)) as first_number
      dash "SP" ((1*digit)) dot ((1*digit))
      colon
      (century 2*digit !digit)
      (
        1*(
          ","
          (
            ((1*digit)) as next_number
            dash "SP" ((1*digit)) dot ((1*digit))
            colon
            (century 2*digit !digit)
          )
        )
      ) as bundle_items
    )
  }
  tutorial_bundle = "CIE Tutorials Bundle" space ((1*digit)) as bundle_number
  identifier = {
    tutorial_bundle
    / bundle_identifier
    / joint_with_iso_cie
    / joint_with_iso
    / joint_with_iec
    / identical_with_iso
    / dis_with_supplement
    / dual_with_iec
    / corrigendum_identifier
    / supplement_identifier
    / standard_with_language_year
    / standard_with_slash_year
    / d_series_identifier
    / conf_proceedings
    / standalone_proceedings
    / legacy_code_with_year
    / conference_identifier
    / annex_letter_identifier
    / annex_identifier
    / standard_identifier
  }
  legacy_code_with_year = {
    "CIE" space
    ((1*digit)) as number
    dash
    (century 2*digit !digit) as year
    [ ((language_paren_year)) ] as trailing_lang
  }

  # Annex forms (rule bodies per source)
  annex_identifier = {
    (base_without_language)
    space "Annexes" as annex_marker
    [
      (
        ( (space (edition_text) as edition_format space (century 2*digit !digit) as year)
        / (colon (century 2*digit !digit) as year)
        )
      )
    ]
    [language_portion]
  }
  annex_letter_identifier = {
    (base_without_language)
    space "Annex" space
    ( (upper) [ (dash upper) ] ) as annex_letter
    [
      (
        ( (space edition_text space (century 2*digit !digit) as year)
        / (colon (century 2*digit !digit) as year)
        )
      )
    ]
    [language_portion]
  }
  base_without_language = "CIE" space ((upper)) as type space full_number_cie [date] [draft_stage_cie]
  draft_stage_cie = space [stage_iteration_cie] ("WD" / "CD") as stage
  stage_iteration_cie = ((((1*digit) dot (1*digit))) / (1*digit)) as iteration
  full_number_cie = ((1*digit)) [(dash ((1*3digit)) as part)]
  language_portion = language_paren / language_slash
  edition_text = "Edition" / "edition"

  nonrparen = %x01-28 / %x29-10FFFF
  nonrparen_nl = %x01-09 / %x0B-28 / %x2A-10FFFF

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    number -> number (string)
    iteration -> iteration (string)
    part -> part (string)
    dash_sep -> dash_sep (string)
    slash_sep -> slash_sep (string)
    year -> year (string)
    current_date -> current_date (raw)
    legacy_date -> legacy_date (raw)
    language_slash -> language_slash (raw)
    language_paren -> language_paren (raw)
    language_paren_year -> language_paren_year (raw)
    lang_before -> lang_before (raw)
    date_then_lang -> date_then_lang (raw)
    trailing_lang -> trailing_lang (raw)
    trans_year -> trans_year (string)
    lang_code -> lang_code (string)
    lang_colon -> lang_colon (string)
    slash_year -> slash_year (string)
    stage -> stage (string)
    s_prefix -> s_prefix (string)
    doc_type -> doc_type (string)
    paper_code -> paper_code (string)
    paper_number -> paper_number (string)
    page_range -> page_range (string)
    conf_number -> conf_number (string)
    conference -> conference (string)
    variant -> variant (string)
    d_prefix -> d_prefix (string)
    base_number -> base_number (string)
    supplement_number -> supplement_number (string)
    supplement_part -> supplement_part (string)
    base_supplement -> base_supplement (string)
    base_supplement_part -> base_supplement_part (string)
    base_year -> base_year (string)
    cor_number -> cor_number (string)
    cor_year -> cor_year (string)
    amd_number -> amd_number (string)
    copublisher -> copublisher (string)
    iso_reference -> iso_reference (string)
    iec_identifier -> iec_identifier (string)
    first_number -> first_number (string)
    bundle_number -> bundle_number (string)
    annex_marker -> annex_marker (string)
    edition_format -> edition_format (string)
    annex_letter -> annex_letter (string)
    type -> type (string)
    next_number -> bundle_items[].next_number (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "CIE S 008/E:2001"
    accept "CIE 15:2018"
    accept "CIE x045-2019"
    accept "CIE S 006.1/1998 (ISO 16508:1999)"
    accept "CIE D001:2017"
    accept "CIE ISO 10916:2024"
    accept "CIE 121-SP1:2009"
    accept "CIE 198-SP1.1:2011,198-SP1.2:2011"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
